description:
We’re looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and building technology that makes an impact. 

 You’ll develop large-scale applications and distributed systems that collect, process, and deliver significant volumes of data, while working collaboratively to turn business and customer needs into effective technical solutions. You may also partner directly with customers and external stakeholders to understand requirements, shape new features, and support the products and systems you help build.

 Key Activities: 
 Builds complex, large scale client applications and/or large distributed systems; owns discrete tasks; designs, develops and tests code
 Solves simpler technical challenges
 May work in cross-functional teams to identify and resolve data quality issues
 Participates in ongoing research and evaluates new systems
 Performs discrete coding tasks; works in a single work stream
 Solves problems of limited scope in a timely manner; fixes bugs; changes minor features
 Follows set coding standards
 Maintains system; provides limited product support
 
 Core Qualifications: 
 Bachelors degree
 0-2 years systems development experience
 Proficient in computing languages
 Experience with HTTP protocols
 Understanding of database architecture
 Strong verbal and written communication skills
 Aptitude/desire to code
 Intellectual curiosity and creativity
 Solid business ethics
 Able to work well in a fast paced, team-oriented environment
 
 About Comscore 

 At Comscore, we’re pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we’re united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. If you’re motivated by big challenges and interested in helping some of the largest and most important media properties and brands navigate the future of media, we’d love to hear from you. 
   
 Comscore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms. With a data footprint that combines digital, over-the-top, and linear TV intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. A proven leader in measuring digital and set-top box audiences and advertising at scale, Comscore is the industry’s emerging, third-party source for reliable and comprehensive cross-platform measurement. To learn more about Comscore, please visit Comscore.com. 
   
 To comply with federal law, Comscore participates in E-Verify. Successful candidates must pass the E-Verify process after hire.

 We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
